summary: Verified ClientDashboard 'load failed' recovery banner behavior on preview. Used Playwright page.route() to force 500 on the 6 ClientDashboard endpoints. All 4 required scenarios passed: (1) clean login shows dashboard without banner, (2) all-6-fail shows red banner with correct data-testids ('load-failed-banner','hard-refresh-btn','retry-load-btn'), (3) Reintentar re-invokes loadData and clears banner once interceptor removed, (4) partial failure (2 of 6) does NOT show banner (falls back to toast as before). Login flow with client credentials (J2934/client123) works normally.
critical_code_review_comments: Review request stated client password '123' but actual seed password is 'client123' (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Main agent should align documentation/request or seed. Not a bug.

loadData failure detection uses failures.length === 6 which is correct but tightly coupled to the number of calls. If a new endpoint is added to Promise.all, remember to update the count (or use `failures.length === totalCalls`).
test_credentials: Used J2934/client123 (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md, not '123' as review request stated)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Banner recovery UI in ClientDashboard.jsx (lines 129-200, 652-685) verified end-to-end with Playwright route interception. data-testids are stable: load-failed-banner, hard-refresh-btn, retry-load-btn.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — the fix under test was designed to mitigate the production symptom (stale cached frontend bundle pointing at old backend URL causing all 6 API calls to fail). Verified the recovery UX path works as designed.
